channel.title: FXStreet Forex & Commodities News
channel.description: Real-time Forex News and the latest trading updates. Stay updated on the latest news about currencies and commodities markets.

item.title: Swiss Franc's recovery stalls despite broad-based US Dollar weakness
item.description: The Swiss Franc (CHF) has trimmed some losses in a quiet market session on Tuesday, as a pullback on US Treasury yields and a mild reversal in Oil prices has undermined support for the safe-haven US Dollar (USD).

item.title: Equities: Earnings beats seen versus consensus – Deutsche Bank
item.description: Deutsche Bank strategists, highlight the start of the United States (US) Q3 earnings season with major banks reporting.

item.title: US Dollar: Overbought signals but no clear catalyst – ING
item.description: ING strategists Francesco Pesole, Frantisek Taborsky and Chris Turner note that several indicators show the Dollar rally is stretched, with the currency overvalued against most G10 peers and positioning extended. However, they argue that without a clear macro or market catalyst, an imminent reversal is unlikely, as sticky Fed tightening expectations and global bond weakness continue to support demand for the Dollar.

item.title: Euro declines as BoJ tightening bets, Eurozone stagflation risks bolster Japanese Yen
item.description: EUR/JPY trades around 176.60 on Tuesday, down 0.21% on the day at the time of writing.

item.title: Silver price today: Silver rises, according to FXStreet data
item.description: Silver prices (XAG/USD) rose on Tuesday, according to FXStreet data. Silver trades at $60.53 per troy ounce, up 0.35% from the $60.31 it cost on Monday.

item.title: Gold Price Forecast: XAU/USD retraces losses as US yields and Oil prices ease
item.description: Gold (XAU/USD) retraces Monday’s losses on Tuesday, favoured by a softer US Dollar (USD) as US Yields ease from highs and Oil prices pull back, with investors awaiting key US inflation reports later in the week for a better assessment of the Federal Reserve’s (Fed) near-term policy.

item.title: Polish Zloty: Pressured by policy and fiscal risks – Commerzbank
item.description: Commerzbank’s Tatha Ghose argues that the environment for the Zloty remains negative.

item.title: Euro strengthens against Canadian Dollar as German HICP inflation accelerates, oil eases
item.description: EUR/CAD recovers its recent losses from the previous day, trading around 1.5950 during European hours on Tuesday. The currency cross appreciates as the Euro (EUR) gains support following the release of Harmonized Index of Consumer Prices (HICP) inflation data from Germany.

item.title: NZD/USD Price Forecast: Recovery from YTD low seems capped; 0.5580 holds the key
item.description: The NZD/USD pair stages a modest recovery from the 0.5580 area, or its lowest level since April 2025, touched earlier this Tuesday, reversing a major part of the previous day's losses.

item.title: Australian Dollar: High rates support Aussie against US Dollar - MUFG
item.description: MUFG's Lee Hardman says the Australian Dollar remains supported by the RBA's 4.60% policy rate and resilient global growth. September meeting minutes signal scope for further tightening, although housing weakness remains a concern.

item.title: Indian Rupee rallies further as RBI step up measures to curb US Dollar’s demand
item.description: The Indian Rupee (INR) extends the Monday’s advance against the US Dollar (USD) on Tuesday, driven by the announcement of fresh Reserve Bank of India’s (RBI) US Dollar-related measures to shore up the domestic currency.

item.title: Dow Jones futures gain as defensive and blue-chip stocks show relative strength
item.description: Dow Jones futures rise by 0.61% to trade near 52,430 during European hours on Tuesday. S&P 500 futures remain steady around 7,850, while Nasdaq 100 futures fall 0.56% to near 30,730.

item.title: British Pound gains as BoE’s Greene favors proactive approach on hot UK inflation
item.description: The British Pound (GBP) trades 0.2% higher at around 1.3233 against the US Dollar (USD) during the European trading session on Tuesday.

item.title: British Pound: Cable confined to broad trading band – UOB
item.description: United Overseas Bank’s (UOB) Quek Ser Leang and Lee Sue Ann observe GBP/USD holding relatively resilient versus the US Dollar (USD) but still drifting lower. Intraday price action shows a tentative downside bias within 1.3190–1.3235.

item.title: Fed’s Waller: Trump is a threat to Fed independence
item.description: Federal Reserve (Fed) Governor Christopher Waller said in the Bloomberg New Economy Forum 2026 discussion on Tuesday that United States (US) President Donald Trump is a threat to central bank’s independence. However, Waller has assured that Trump is not succeeding in the same.

item.title: WTI slides to near $91.50 as Russian diesel inflow offsets geopolitical escalations
item.description: West Texas Intermediate (WTI) oil price halts its three-day winning streak, trading around $91.50 per barrel during European hours on Tuesday. Crude oil prices fell as traders weighed the impact of new Russian diesel exports against escalating geopolitical tensions.

item.title: Euro trims losses amid a softer USD, with upside attempts likely to remain shallow
item.description: The Euro (EUR) shows moderate gains on Tuesday, rather due to the US Dollar’s (USD) weakness than intrinsic Euro strength.

item.title: Gold bulls seem hesitant below $4,200 as hawkish Fed offset USD weakness
item.description: Gold (XAU/USD) retains a mildly positive bias through the first half of the European session, though it remains capped below the $4,200 mark and the top boundary of a two-week-old trading range.

item.title: Japanese Yen: Intervention risks limit further depreciation - OCBC
item.description: OCBC strategists Sim Moh Siong and Christopher Wong describe USD/JPY as a patience trade, with the pair supported by higher US yields and elevated energy prices but capped by extreme Japanese Yen undervaluation and rising intervention risks.

item.title: USD/CAD Price Forecast: Falls to near 1.4250 near nine-day EMA support
item.description: USD/CAD depreciates after two days of gains, trading around 1.4260 during European hours on Tuesday. The technical analysis of the daily chart indicates that the price is remaining within the ascending channel pattern, suggesting a persistent bullish bias.

item.title: AUD/JPY Price Forecast: Awaits 110.00 break as Yen strength validates bearish setup on H4
item.description: The AUD/JPY cross comes under some renewed selling pressure on Tuesday and retreats further from the 110.65 resistance zone, retesting the previous day.

item.title: Equities: Rotation out of AI as breadth stays positive – Danske Bank
item.description: Danske Research Team highlights that global equities finished broadly flat, masking notable rotation as investors cut AI and semiconductor exposure. Europe and defensive sectors outperformed, with consumer staples leading.

item.title: Indian Rupee: RBI support points to softer pair – Commerzbank
item.description: Commerzbank’s India section notes September CPI at 5.5% year-on-year, above August and near breaching the RBI’s target band, with risks skewed to the upside from Oil, INR weakness and El Niño.

item.title: Silver Price Forecast: XAG/USD remains capped below $61.00 as bulls seem hesitant
item.description: Silver (XAG/USD) attracts some dip-buyers in the vicinity of mid-$59.00s on Tuesday and sticks to its modest intraday gains through the early European session. The white metal, however, lacks bullish conviction and currently trades around the $60.50 area, up just over 0.30% for the day.

item.title: Euro remains depressed against British Pound as France and Oil weighs
item.description: The Euro (EUR) shows a frail recovery attempt against the British Pound (GBP) on Tuesday but remains broadly bearish, after a nearly 2% selloff in just over two weeks.

item.title: Oil: Market focuses on Persian Gulf risks – ING
item.description: ING strategists Warren Patterson and Ewa Manthey note that Oil prices remain supported as traders focus on Middle East and Persian Gulf supply risks rather than the Russia-Ukraine energy ceasefire. Brent has pushed back toward $107/bbl, while hurricane-related disruptions in the Gulf of Mexico and Saudi plans to expand pipeline capacity add further supply-side complexity for the market.

item.title: Forex Today: US Dollar retreats from 18-month high as bond yields, oil prices ease
item.description: Here is what you need to know on Tuesday, October 13:

item.title: AUD/USD Price Forecast: Declining 20-day EMA builds case for more downside
item.description: The Australian Dollar (AUD) is marginally higher at around 0.6960 against the US Dollar (USD) during the European trading session on Tuesday.

item.title: Euro: Gradual downside toward key support against US Dollar – UOB
item.description: United Overseas Bank’s (UOB) Quek Ser Leang and Lee Sue Ann highlight ongoing Euro (EUR) weakness against the US Dollar (USD), with EUR/USD at fresh 17‑month lows. Intraday, further losses are possible but seen contained within 1.1145–1.1185.

item.title: USD/JPY Price Forecast: Bulls fail to break the 200-day SMA around 158.50
item.description: The US Dollar (USD) edges lower against the Japanese Yen (JPY) on Tuesday, although it maintains its broader bullish trend intact, favoured by a risk-averse market.
